title: ScannyBoyRollManifest
description: scanny-boy-roll.json: one roll's durable record. See docs/PHASE3_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md section 3.3.

filmBase.description: REBATE_ANCHORING section 3.1: the roll's film-base reference — the per-channel median log density inside the film rebate of one dedicated reference frame, the thin-end colour anchor for every negative on the roll. Attached by `roll set-base-frame`; replaceable while `locked_at` is null; frozen for the life of the roll once the first negative has been published against it. `density` is always a 3-array, even on a monochrome roll (section 5); `populations` is the full detector output, thinnest first, kept as evidence.

density.description: The chosen population's per-channel median log10 density.

locked_at.description: Null while replaceable; an ISO-8601 UTC timestamp once the roll's first negative has been published against the reference. The only lock state.

flat_field_profile_id.description: The profile whose gain map the measurement used; null when none was given.

camera_model.description: The base frame's EXIF camera model; null when the EXIF carries none.

clipped_fractions.description: Per-channel clipped fraction inside the chosen population only.

baseCheck.description: REBATE_ANCHORING section 6: how this negative's own rebate compares with the roll's locked anchor. Recorded, read by nothing — the evidence a future drift threshold would need.

level_offset.description: The common-mode difference, median(neg) - median(roll): capture-exposure drift across the roll.

shape_residual.description: The largest per-channel disagreement AFTER removing that common mode: the direct measure of whether the roll anchor is right.

cameraColor.description: The capturing body's colour response (docs/EXPORT_PLAN.md section 3.2): written by the stitch stage's first run from the run's first source, frozen thereafter. Recorded data for the export path, not a roll invariant (section 3.3). A colour roll with no camera_color fails the export (CAMERA_MATRIX_MISSING).

channelArray.description: Per-channel values: one entry per published channel - 3 on a colour roll, 1 on a mono roll's collapsed image (MONOCHROME_PLAN section 4). Existing colour rolls carry 3 and validate unchanged.

filmDecision.description: The roll's film kind, set at `roll init` and never rewritten. Legacy manifests may carry extra detector-era fields (`source`, `statistic`, `samples`, `detector_version`); they are ignored.

statistic.description: Legacy: the deciding median chroma statistic from the retired auto-detector.

samples.description: Legacy: which negatives' `mono` evidence the auto-detector sampled.

scan_clip_fractions.description: Per-channel fraction of pixels at or above sensor white, measured in the prepare stage at decode; null when the contributing run predates the measurement.

rectification.description: The negative's fitted rig-tilt rectification (docs/RECTIFICATION_PLAN.md section 7): one shared W = [[1,0,0],[0,1,0],[l1,l2,1]] acting on points centred at `centre`, with the fit's own before/after diagnostics. Absent when the fit was rejected or the build predates it.

mono.description: MONOCHROME_PLAN section 1: the film-kind detector's evidence for this negative, recorded beside the other section 3.7 meters and acted on by nothing. Present only on sampled negatives.

base_density.description: Three-way on purpose: null (clipped base or nothing detected), or the per-channel median log density at 1 or 3 entries.

opaque.description: The opaque-holder gate's finding (docs/DECISIONS.md, "Normalization decisions"). `threshold` is the absolute log density it fired at, null with nothing withheld. Declared late (BLACK_POINT_REFINEMENT §4.1): the block was written by earlier builds but never declared here.

film_extent.description: The film-extent pass's finding (docs/BLACK_POINT_REFINEMENT.md): where the film's own extent was judged to sit and how far the meters' region was inset inside it. `insets` is (top, bottom, left, right) in GRID CELLS -- `analysis_block_px` in processing_params multiplies to canvas pixels, and `analysis_rect` beside it is in canvas pixels. `valley` is the absolute log density the film/non-film split was made at; `rebate_agrees` is the §5.3 cross-check, recorded and read by nothing.

highlight_refs.description: CAST_REMOVAL_PLAN R-1 (section 3.2): the dense end's shared, chroma-gated same-pixel neutral reference, normalized against the negative's own bounds; null when the band held no trustworthy neutrals or the negative predates the meter. Recorded, read by nothing in the stitch stage.

neutral_residual.description: CAST_REMOVAL_PLAN R-1 (section 3.1): the frame's residual neutral offset (R-G, B-G) in normalized units, measured on the grid normalized by the published bounds; null when there was no estimate. Recorded, read by nothing in the stitch stage.

negativeMetadata.description: The negative's explicit extended-metadata values; null means inherit the roll-level fallback.

normalization_aggregate.description: D-4: the per-channel median of the run's negatives' bounds; recorded, nothing reads it yet.

sequence.description: Rank among completed negatives; null while unranked (pending/failed).

preview_path.description: CLI-generated preview of the negative as its edits render so far; null until first generated.

normalized_fill.description: Section 3.14's uncovered-canvas fill value, recorded so a file is interpretable without knowing which build wrote it.

grid.description: The negative's grid as declared (docs/GRID_STITCH_PLAN.md section 2.4); null for a pre-grid build.

grid_cells.description: The solved cell assignment, member name -> [row, col]; null when no non-strip grid was declared or assignment failed.

grid_pitch_ratio.description: Grid regularity check (a): min/max adjacent-cell-pitch ratio, worst axis; null when no axis has three positions.

grid_alignment_ratio.description: Grid regularity check (b): worst cross-axis row/column spread over the median pitch; 0 for a perfect grid.

rotation_quarter_turns.description: Derived, not stored: present in `roll info` output only — the ops log's net clockwise quarter turns.

flipped_horizontally.description: Derived, not stored: present in `roll info` output only — whether the ops log's net transform includes a horizontal mirror.

fine_rotation_deg.description: Derived, not stored: present in `roll info` output only — the ops log's net clockwise fine rotation in degrees (the auto-seeded rebate squaring, composed with any user ops).

tone_grade_r.description: Derived, not stored: present in `roll info` output only — the net ISO-R paper grade from the latest `tone` op.

tone_snap_gamma.description: Derived, not stored: present in `roll info` output only — the net midtone snap from the latest `tone` op.

tone_density.description: Derived, not stored: present in `roll info` output only — the net print density from the latest `tone` op.

tone_shadow_density.description: Derived, not stored: present in `roll info` output only — the net shadows density from the latest `tone` op.

tone_highlight_density.description: Derived, not stored: present in `roll info` output only — the net highlights density from the latest `tone` op.

tone_toe.description: Derived, not stored: present in `roll info` output only — the net toe from the latest `tone` op.

tone_toe_width.description: Derived, not stored: present in `roll info` output only — the net toe width from the latest `tone` op.

tone_shoulder.description: Derived, not stored: present in `roll info` output only — the net shoulder from the latest `tone` op.

tone_shoulder_width.description: Derived, not stored: present in `roll info` output only — the net shoulder width from the latest `tone` op.

color_wb_cyan.description: Derived, not stored: present in `roll info` output only — global cyan from the latest `color` op.

color_wb_magenta.description: Derived, not stored: present in `roll info` output only — global magenta from the latest `color` op.

color_wb_yellow.description: Derived, not stored: present in `roll info` output only — global yellow from the latest `color` op.

color_shadow_cyan.description: Derived, not stored: present in `roll info` output only — shadow cyan from the latest `color` op.

color_shadow_magenta.description: Derived, not stored: present in `roll info` output only — shadow magenta from the latest `color` op.

color_shadow_yellow.description: Derived, not stored: present in `roll info` output only — shadow yellow from the latest `color` op.

color_highlight_cyan.description: Derived, not stored: present in `roll info` output only — highlight cyan from the latest `color` op.

color_highlight_magenta.description: Derived, not stored: present in `roll info` output only — highlight magenta from the latest `color` op.

color_highlight_yellow.description: Derived, not stored: present in `roll info` output only — highlight yellow from the latest `color` op.

color_cast_removal.description: Derived, not stored: present in `roll info` output only — cast removal from the latest `color` op.

color_dye_separation.description: Derived, not stored: present in `roll info` output only — dye separation from the latest `color` op.

color_separation_damping.description: Derived, not stored: present in `roll info` output only — separation damping from the latest `color` op.

color_cast_removal_highlights.description: Derived, not stored: present in `roll info` output only — the highlight-end cast-removal tie strength from the latest `color` op (docs/CAST_REMOVAL_PLAN.md §7.4).

color_temperature.description: Derived, not stored: present in `roll info` output only — nominal Kelvin readout from global magenta/yellow; null when no `color` op.

published_icc_profile.description: The density profile the published TIFFs carry (docs/DECISIONS.md, "Normalization decisions").

film.description: MONOCHROME_PLAN section 2.3. Optional (unlike every other top-level field) even though current builds always write it: a manifest predating section 2 has none, and section 5.2 treats a missing block as an implicit frozen colour rather than requiring a migration.

film_base.description: REBATE_ANCHORING section 3.1. Optional because a roll predating the feature (or one with no base frame attached yet) has none; run/stitch refuse such a roll with FILM_BASE_REQUIRED.
